description: Exceptional air-conditioned flat in the centre of Paris, brand new (April 2024)Just a stone's throw from Place de l'Opéra and Galeries Lafayette, between Place Vendôme, Rue de la Paix and Rue du Faubourg Saint Honoré, you can walk to the Louvre in just 9 minutes.This upmarket 4-bedroom, 4-bathroom flat is elegant, modern, fully equipped and decorated by renowned architects, making it ideal for a successful stay with family or friends.The spaceExceptional air-conditioned apartment located in the center of Paris, completely new (April 2024)A stone's throw from Place de l'Opéra, Galeries Lafayette, halfway between Place Vendôme, rue de la Paix, and rue du Faubourg Saint Honoré, you can enjoy a stroll in the Tuileries gardens and get to the Louvre in 9 minutes on foot.This high-end apartment with 4 bedrooms and 4 bathrooms, elegant, modern, fully equipped, and decorated by renowned architects is ideal for a successful stay with family or friends.Air-conditioned apartment of 140 m2 on the 2nd floor with an elevator which includes:- 1 living room with sofa, coffee table, 1 large dining table with chairs for 8 people Smart TV and WI FI- 1 fully equipped open kitchen with 1 table and 1 bench (hob, oven, microwave, toaster, Nespresso machine, kettle, washer-dryer)- 2 bedrooms with queen size bed and private bathroom with bathtub and without toilet- 2 bedrooms with queen bed and private bathroom with shower without toilet- 2 individual toilets- 1 continuous balcony with small outdoor tables and chairsThe cleaning fee includes fresh linens and towels for each guest and cleaning is carried out by a professional housekeeperWe will be delighted to welcome you to our apartment, please let us know your arrival time in order to organize check-in.In case of late arrival, check-in is €30
